items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping dry, sensitive-looking skin.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, well-cushioned skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 that is gentle on easily flushed skin and protects against sun exposure that can make redness look worse.

response.routine_note: Flushing that lingers, bumps and gritty eyes are best looked at in person by a dermatologist or eye care professional rather than by anything we sell, so I removed the glycolic toner and the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash, which are too harsh for dry, sensitive skin and could make the look of redness worse. In the meantime, use the gentle cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, and apply the mineral SPF each morning as the last step.
